# Tool-selection qualification

`v1.json` labels correct proposals, incorrect proposals and planner declines independently of JEV output. Supply a complete announced catalog, including server-owned descriptions, schemas and annotations, to `venv/bin/python scripts/qualify_tool_routing.py --catalog <catalog.json> --model <model> --output <fresh-result.json>`. Credentials come only from `PHOENIX_QUALIFICATION_API_KEY` or the explicitly named environment variable. The runner sends synthetic tasks to the configured endpoint, makes no tool calls and records catalog/baseline hashes, returned distributions, HTTP attempts, latency and reported usage. It stops on authentication or context-capacity failure without hiding candidates.

This first-stage measurement never qualifies active advice by itself. Every labeled case must pass before paired Off/Advise evaluations using the same model, catalogs, task fixtures and constraints. The paired gate requires no safety/refusal regression, no reduction in task success and demonstrated correction of wrong proposals. Record latency and combined conversational/decision usage separately. A decision-only failure blocks admission; do not spend on paired execution or populate the qualification registry after such a failure. The runtime starts with no qualified models. Mocked tests exercise correction paths without claiming hosted accuracy.
